title: HubSpot Marketing Hub vs ActiveCampaign: Testing the Best AI Marketing Tools for Ecommerce - Ecommerce-Platforms.com

facts.fact: HubSpot Marketing Hub's integration ecosystem is listed as 2,000 apps, with deep two-way data sync to tools such as Shopify, Slack, and Stripe, according to the article's comparison table.
facts.quote: 2,000 apps; deep two-way data sync (Shopify, Slack, Stripe etc.)

facts.fact: ActiveCampaign's integration ecosystem is listed as 1,000 apps, with good email integrations and heavier reliance on Zapier, according to the article's comparison table.
facts.quote: 1,000 apps; good email integrations, heavier reliance on Zapier

facts.fact: According to the article's comparison table, ActiveCampaign provides native support for 75 languages.
facts.quote: native support for 75 languages

facts.fact: According to the article's comparison table, ActiveCampaign offers free 1:1 migration on the Pro plan and above.
facts.quote: Free 1:1 migration (Pro +)

facts.fact: According to the article's comparison table, HubSpot's CRM is free, while its hubs are tiered by users and features.
facts.quote: Free CRM, tiered hubs (users + features)

facts.fact: According to the article's comparison table, HubSpot's pipelines are capped by plan.
facts.quote: pipelines capped by plan

facts.fact: According to the article's comparison table, ActiveCampaign's built-in CRM includes unlimited pipelines on all plans.
facts.quote: Built-in CRM with unlimited pipelines on all plans

facts.fact: According to the article's comparison table, ActiveCampaign uses contact-based pricing, which is cheaper to start but scales quickly.
facts.quote: Contact-based pricing; cheaper start but scales fast

facts.fact: The author reports being able to set up conditions and start firing personalized automations in ActiveCampaign in less than an hour.
facts.quote: start firing personalized automations in less than an hour

facts.fact: The author reports that with ActiveCampaign they were sending a campaign within half an hour of starting setup.
facts.quote: You’ll be sending a campaign within half an hour

facts.fact: The author says ActiveCampaign's Predictive Sending and Active Intelligence tools improved a lot in 2025.
facts.quote: they’ve improved a lot in 2025

facts.fact: The article was published on April 13, 2026.
The article's author says HubSpot offers more than 2000 integrations.
facts.quote: there are more than 2000 integrations to explore

facts.fact: The article's author says ActiveCampaign offers about a thousand integrations.
facts.quote: ActiveCampaign still gives you about a thousand integrations

facts.fact: The article says HubSpot's Sales Hub Starter tier costs around $20 per user per month, with Marketing Hub slightly more.
facts.quote: around $20 per user per month for Sales, slightly more for Marketing

facts.fact: The article says ActiveCampaign's entry cost is about $39 per month for 2,500 contacts.
facts.quote: You can get started for about $39 a month for 2,500 contacts

facts.fact: The article states HubSpot offers a free CRM tier.
facts.quote: HubSpot starts with a genuinely free CRM.

facts.fact: The article states ActiveCampaign charges by number of contacts rather than by users.
facts.quote: The entry cost is low because it charges by contacts, not users.

facts.fact: The article states the number of HubSpot pipelines increases with the subscription plan.
facts.quote: the number of pipelines grows with your plan

facts.fact: The article states ActiveCampaign integrates with Postmark for transactional emails.
facts.quote: ActiveCampaign integrates neatly with Postmark

facts.fact: The article states ActiveCampaign can send SMS or WhatsApp messages directly from its automation builder.
facts.quote: You can send SMS or WhatsApp messages directly from the same automation builder

facts.fact: The article states HubSpot's Data Hub can link Shopify, Google Ads, or a data warehouse with automatic syncing.
facts.quote: now you can link Shopify, Google Ads, or a data warehouse, and it all stays synced automatically

facts.fact: The article states that HubSpot can integrate with Shopify or Stripe to run an ecommerce store from within the CRM.
facts.quote: It syncs with Shopify or Stripe, and you can send quotes, take payments, even automate "cart abandoned" emails without leaving the CRM.
